sets.title: Payment processor clones with extractable validate() method
sets.description: Three payment processor classes with identical validate() methods that can be pulled up to an abstract base class.
sets.solution:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Acme\Payment\Unified;

abstract class AbstractPaymentProcessor
{
    protected float $amount;
    protected string $currency;

    protected function validate(): bool
    {
        if (empty($this->amount) || $this->amount <= 0) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Invalid amount');
        }
        if (empty($this->currency)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Currency required');
        }
        return true;
    }
}

sets.title: Notification service clones with extractable send() method
sets.description: Three notifier classes with identical send() methods that can be extracted into a trait.
sets.solution:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

trait NotifiableTrait
{
    abstract protected function getApiKey(): string;
    abstract protected function getRecipient(): string;
    abstract protected function getMessage(): string;
    abstract protected function getEndpoint(): string;

    public function send(): bool
    {
        $headers = ['Content-Type' => 'application/json', 'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $this->getApiKey()];
        $payload = json_encode(['recipient' => $this->getRecipient(), 'message' => $this->getMessage()]);
        $ch = curl_init($this->getEndpoint());
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_POST => true,
            CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => $payload,
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => $this->buildHeaders($headers),
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 30
        ]);
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        if (curl_errno($ch)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Send failed: ' . curl_error($ch));
        }
        curl_close($ch);
        return json_decode($response, true);
    }
}

sets.title: Report builder clones with extractable base class
sets.description: Three report builder classes with duplicate setTitle, setDateRange, addFilter, and generate methods that can be pulled up to an abstract base class.
sets.solution:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

abstract class AbstractReportBuilder
{
    protected string $title;
    protected string $dateRange;
    protected array $filters = [];

    public function setTitle(string $title): self
    {
        $this->title = $title;
        return $this;
    }

    public function setDateRange(string $dateRange): self
    {
        $this->dateRange = $dateRange;
        return $this;
    }

    public function addFilter(string $filter): self
    {
        $this->filters[] = $filter;
        return $this;
    }

    public function generate(): array
    {
        $data = $this->fetchData();
        $this->validateData($data);
        return $this->formatOutput($data);
    }

    abstract protected function fetchData(): array;
    abstract protected function formatOutput(array $data): array;

    protected function validateData(array $data): void
    {
        if (empty($this->title)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Report title is required');
        }
        if (empty($this->dateRange)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Date range is required');
        }
    }
}

sets.title: State machine clones with extractable transition methods
sets.description: Three state machine classes with duplicate canTransition() and transition() methods that can be pulled up to an abstract base class.
sets.solution:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

abstract class AbstractStateMachine
{
    protected string $currentState;
    protected array $transitions = [];

    public function canTransition(string $toState): bool
    {
        return isset($this->transitions[$this->currentState])
            && in_array($toState, $this->transitions[$this->currentState]);
    }

    public function transition(string $toState): bool
    {
        if (!$this->canTransition($toState)) {
            throw new \InvalidOperationException(
                'Invalid transition from ' . $this->currentState . ' to ' . $toState
            );
        }
        $this->currentState = $toState;
        $this->onTransition($toState);
        return true;
    }

    protected function onTransition(string $toState): void
    {
        // Hook for subclasses
    }
}
